product_overview: Codemify Demo App is a full-stack e-commerce demonstration application designed to provide a realistic online shopping experience. Featuring product catalog display, shopping cart management, checkout process with comprehensive form validation, and a RESTful backend API, it serves as an educational platform for QA professionals and developers to practice testing and explore modern web development practices.
core_goals: Provide an interactive and visually appealing product catalog for users to browse available items.
Implement a robust shopping cart system allowing users to add, update, and remove products seamlessly.
Ensure a comprehensive checkout flow with real-time form validations to improve data accuracy and user experience.
Offer a RESTful API backend with full product CRUD support backed by JSON file storage.
Maintain high-quality user experience with responsive design, intuitive navigation, and error handling.
key_features: Grid-based product catalog displaying images, names, descriptions, and prices with fallback image handling.
Full shopping cart functionality including add-to-cart, quantity updates, item removal, and cart total calculation.
Complete checkout process with validated shipping and payment forms (ZIP code, card number, expiry date, CVV) and order summary.
REST API endpoints for product management (GET all, GET single, POST new, DELETE) with JSON persistence.
React hooks-based state management for frontend data and navigation.
Multi-page navigation system with active state indicators and cart badge display.
Simulated order processing with confirmation and cart clearing upon success.
user_flow_summary: User browses product catalog and views product details in a grid layout.
User adds desired products to shopping cart with visual cart badge updates.
User accesses cart to modify item quantities or remove items, with real-time total updates.
User proceeds to checkout where shipping and payment information is entered and validated dynamically.
User reviews order summary and submits the order for processing.
Order confirmation is displayed and cart is cleared upon successful completion.
validation_criteria: All products must display correctly with images or fallback UI on image load errors.
Shopping cart must update badge counts accurately and maintain state during session.
Quantity updates and item removal functionalities operate without error and update totals correctly.
Checkout form fields must validate against specified patterns (ZIP code, card number length, expiry format, CVV digits).
API endpoints must correctly respond to CRUD operations with appropriate HTTP status codes and error handling.
Order processing simulates delay and displays success confirmation while clearing the cart.
Navigation between pages is smooth with active states visually indicated.
The product catalog grid and application UI are fully responsive and accessible across devices and browsers.

features.name: Product Catalog Display
features.description: Displays a grid of products with images, names, descriptions, prices, and add-to-cart functionality. Includes image fallback handling and product count display.

features.name: Shopping Cart Management
features.description: Full shopping cart functionality including adding items, updating quantities, removing items, and displaying cart totals. Includes cart badge showing item count in header.

features.name: Checkout Process
features.description: Complete checkout flow with form validation for shipping and payment information. Includes order summary, form validation patterns (ZIP code, card number, expiry date, CVV), and success confirmation.

features.name: REST API - Products
features.description: RESTful API endpoints for product CRUD operations: GET all products, GET single product, POST new product, DELETE product. Uses JSON file-based persistence.

features.name: Application State Management
features.description: React hooks-based state management for products, cart, and page navigation. Includes useEffect for fetching data and useState for managing cart state.

features.name: Navigation System
features.description: Multi-page navigation between Products, Cart, and Checkout views with active state indicators and cart badge display.

features.name: Form Validation
features.description: Comprehensive form validation for checkout including ZIP code patterns (12345 or 12345-6789), card number validation (13-19 digits), expiry date format (MM/YY), and CVV validation (3-4 digits).

features.name: Price Calculation
features.description: Cart total calculation with quantity-based pricing. Note: Contains a bug where prices are multiplied by 1.1 in getTotalPrice function.

features.name: Image Handling
features.description: Product image display with error handling and fallback UI using colored divs when images fail to load.

features.name: Order Processing
features.description: Simulated order processing with 2-second delay and success confirmation message. Clears cart upon completion.
